terms.gloss: a wreath, garland, crown (of flowers or leaves)
terms.comment: Worn at feasts and festivals and given as a prize; the crown of a king is diadēma. Lewis & Short marks the second o as common; the house writes it long, as Traupman does.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 409.
